title: Resilient Storm Water Management Leading to Climate Adaptation for Hong Kong, China
summary: This C40 case study describes “Resilient Storm Water Management Leading to Climate Adaptation for Hong Kong, China,” an urban initiative documented for Hong Kong, China. It is included because it addresses river flood, coastal flood, tropical storm hazards, and it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: Hong Kong’s Drainage Services Department has completed a series of plans and surveys that have adequately prepared the city for typhoons.
